summary: Iteration 66 — Business Services admin pricing editor + new Business Website service. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (services list = 11, business-website in Govt Documentation with INR 35,000 / year + USD 2,500 / year and 11 benefits/5 process/4 FAQs; GET/PUT /api/services/admin/rates enforce require_admin (401 without token), list has all required fields, PUT persists, ignores unknown slugs, immediately live on /api/services and /api/service/<slug>; INTL edit and clear works; service-request submit works). critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/services/admin/rates writes a full replacement map ({slug: {IN,INTL}}); any slug omitted from the payload loses its override. This is by design in the current UI (which always sends the full draft) but is worth flagging — a partial-update caller would silently wipe unrelated overrides.
services.py imports notify_admin lazily inside submit_service_request; fine but keep aware of circular-import cost per request.
